rule: First 90 seconds: a 16-beat cold open timed to the title track (skippable by Enter or by reaching beat 16), then a title that waits for a press; the press gives a flash, haptic and medal, then a 2-second delay to the menu. Pre-fight: five beat steps (Before, 3, 2, 1, GO, After) on the conductor, started five beats before song time. Hits: categorised by absolute millisecond offset into perfect, sick, good, bad, shit, miss; only sick triggers the splash; health moves by a fixed per-category fraction of max, starting at half. Results: rank from tallies (all sick = perfect gold; else completion thresholds 0.90 / 0.80 / 0.60) sets a fixed frame table (1/24 s) for music, character, flash and highscore reveal. Base code has no level lock (isUnlocked returns true; lock icon is a TODO); the tutorial song is the default story level, freeplay song and character-hint context.
keep: Beat-counted cold open with a skip by any press and one flash per cut
Five-step count-in on the beat before the first note
Pooled splash reused with a small random frame-rate change so repeat hits differ
Rank-paced results reveal with a fixed frame table per rank
Default selection that drops a new player straight into the tutorial song
Practice mode that removes death (as a non-ledger flag only, for us)
change: No rhythm judgement windows for duels (fights are not on a beat)
No client-side health: our hit result is server-verified, client plays flash and splash only
Replace the words, art, sound family and palette of the cold open
Show the lock state of locked content: the donor leaves the lock icon as a TODO
Fix stale comment: sick bonus comment says 1.0 percent, value is 1.5 percent of max
look_test: On a 375-wide phone: a 16-step cold open of white text on black, timed to a steady beat with one flash at the end and tap-to-skip; then a five-step count-in over the duel ring with the same flash on Go; then a results card whose reveal pause depends on rank. Judge: does the first 90 seconds feel like a reward with no menu hunt and no text wall? Score 1 to 5 for wanting the next fight.
